ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

We're looking for an experienced, driven Senior Strategic Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs' growth across the Nordic's largest enterprises, with a specific focus on Industrials and Telecommunications. Our ideal candidate has a well-established network and a proven track record of selling to C-level and senior decision-makers at major industrial and telecom organizations in the Nordics — and is passionate about the transformative possibilities of AI voice technology.

In this role you'll act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor, enabling clients to leverage our industry-leading models and ElevenAgents — our end-to-end platform for building and deploying AI voice agents — to reimagine their customer experience, internal workflows, and monetization strategies.

In this role you will:

1. Build and manage a growing portfolio of strategic accounts across the Nordics, with a primary focus on Industrials and Telecommunications, to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals.

2. Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs' conversational AI capabilities, including ElevenAgents, can drive customer engagement, contact center automation, and operational efficiency for industrial and telecom organizations.

3. Lead consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, building compelling business cases that translate AI voice technology into measurable business value for senior executives and economic buyers.

4. Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends, particularly as they apply to the Nordics industrial and telecom organizations.

5. Demonstrate expertise, or a strong willingness to learn, about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs' voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, IVR modernization, and in-app assistants.

6. Develop and execute account strategies to expand ElevenLabs' presence within the Nordics industrials and telecom sectors, navigating complex procurement and organizational structures.

7. Partner closely with Customer Success, FDEs and Solutions Engineering to ensure smooth onboarding, deployment, and expansion of accounts.

8. Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, educating C-suite and senior operations leaders on emerging trends in generative AI, voice interfaces, and conversational agents.

Requirements

- 7+ years of quota-carrying strategic sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms.

- Proven success closing deals and managing long, complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across business, IT, legal, and procurement.

- Well-connected in the Nordics industrials and telecom landscape, with an existing network of senior individuals and strong executive presence and ability to build relationships at the C-suite and board level.

- Experience selling technical solutions to product and engineering leaders; ability to translate complex technology into business value.

- Deep understanding of enterprise procurement and legal processes in the Nordics, with the ability to accelerate deal velocity within complex organizational structures.

- Comfort operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment, including building new playbooks and iterating quickly.

- Passion for voice and audio AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers.

- A hybrid of customer and product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction and scale.

- Native or full professional proficiency in Swedish or Danish; strong English for internal collaboration.

Location

This is an in-country role with a preference for a candidate based in Stockholm or Copenhagen. You can work remotely or from our office in Stockholm.

Slate Operations keeps Scopely's game development slate moving. We oversee execution and cross-functional alignment across the games in development — connecting game teams and central teams so decisions get made once and stick, running the cadence that keeps everyone aligned, and clearing the path so teams can build.

What You'll Do:

We're looking for a Director, Slate Operations to own this end to end. There are two sides to it: keeping the Group running as an organization — its cadence, process, and the day-to-day support the Game Board, Head of Slate Development and leadership team rely on — and running program management for the Game Development Framework (GDF) so games move cleanly from concept to launch. You'll sit inside the Slate Development Group but work with every part of Scopely: game teams, divisional leadership, finance, strategy, and corporate development.

• Be the operational point of contact for specific in-development games — running the GDF cadence and connecting game and central teams so decisions get made once and aren't re-litigated. The main goal is to be the end to end steward for game teams in the game development framework.

• Drive the cross-slate operating model so independent game teams reuse what already works instead of rebuilding it.
• Bring structure to consequential decisions — organize the inputs, assumptions, and trade-offs early so the owners and the room can reach real alignment before committing.
• Own a capstone project — one meaty area you drive end to end, for example: evolving the GDF, owning launch readiness, or operationalizing central partnerships, depending on where the need is.
• Keep investment decisions well-informed — track progress across games at different stages, and surface Greenlight Case, budget, staffing, and dependency status so leadership can challenge and decide.
• Unblock teams through the development cycle, especially at launch readiness, by clearing operational issues with central partners (legal, IT, procurement, finance, logistics) so teams stay focused on the game. Partner with marketing, strategy, and divisional leadership so launches go out clean.
• Give teams operational support — production perspective, process, facilitation, and help navigating the GDF.
• Operationalize playtests and validation — help build and run research, playtest, and validation plans, and package the findings so vertical owners and leaders can form the recommendation.
• Utilize the latest AI technologies to keep information flowing — the dashboards, status, and key dates people need to see, without the overhead.

• Bachelor's degree, MBA a plus — or the equivalent in experience.
• 10+ years in program/project management across tech and direct-to-consumer businesses, at least 5 of them in games, working within or alongside a development team.
• You know how games get made and sold — development, publishing, platforms, business models. You don't need to have shipped one yourself, but you get what game teams are up against.
• You've supported senior execs in a fast-moving environment and you like the pace — taking initiative, juggling priorities, switching gears without losing the thread.
• You can run a lot of projects at once, ideally a mix of R&D and live.
• You're comfortable in ambiguity and good at creating clarity for other people. You make sound calls in the company's interest and know when to escalate.
• You can hold your own with P&Ls and free-to-play KPIs.
• You spot the process that's slowing people down and fix it — and you'll push back and start the right debate when it matters.
• You build trust with all kinds of people at every level and don't flinch at the hard conversations — with the presence to grow into a partner to senior game leaders over time.
• You write clearly and fast, and you can build a strong deck with cross-functional input.
• Detail and organization come naturally to you.
• Low ego, business outcomes first, open to feedback — and genuinely curious about every part of the business.
• You play games and care about the industry.

The Modeling and Analytics Graduate Network (MAGNet) program is a unique multi-semester internship opportunity designed to prepare graduate students for a full-time data science position at State Farm. Throughout their time in the program, MAGNet interns apply their predictive modeling and analytical skills to a variety of data science problems to augment their theoretical coursework while also developing professionally.

It is not feasible to expose interns to the full variety of topics they need to be familiar with for full-time data science work in a single semester. As such, the MAGNet internship is designed to last the duration of an intern's graduate studies with renewal on a semester-by-semester basis. This means that while this position is hiring for the Spring 2027 semester, the intern may be invited to return for following semester(s), based on the intern's growth and progress relative to the internship's expectations. To continue in the MAGNet program, it is expected that an intern continue to renew their internship throughout their graduate program for the Spring, Summer, and Fall semesters as applicable. If you are looking for a summer or other short-term internship, MAGNet is not the right fit for you, but you may be interested in State Farm's summer internship programs.

Graduate students at the University of Georgia (UGA) in highly quantitative disciplines are considered, with an emphasis on understanding of statistical techniques. While participating in the MAGNet program, students are evaluated and given consideration for full time, post-graduate employment at various State Farm locations: Atlanta, GA; Bloomington, IL; Dallas, TX; or Tempe, AZ. 회사 소개

CFS (Coupang Fulfillment Services)는 쿠팡의 물류를 총괄하는 쿠팡의 계열사입니다. CFS 는 물류센터 또는 FC (Fulfillment Center) 운영을 책임지고 있으며, 업무 효율성과 전문성 제고를 통해 글로벌 커머스 기업으로 성장하기 위한 혁신을 이끌어 가고 있습니다.

쿠팡의 FC 는 상품의 입고, 적재, 포장, 출고 및 반품 등 사후 처리에 이르는 다양한 분야의 전문가들이 함께 일하고 있습니다. FC 는 단순한 물류 창고와 다르게 공장 자동화 (Factory Automation) 솔루션과 첨단 기술을 활용하고 있습니다. 제조업 생산 공장과 같이 각각의 업무를 전문화하고, 입고부터 출고까지 데이터를 기반으로 시공간을 효율적으로 관리하여 낭비를 최소화하는 등 최적의 물류 시스템을 구현해 나가고 있습니다.

CFS 는 물류 혁신을 통해 고객이 "쿠팡 없이 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말하는 세상을 만들고자 합니다. 우리의 역동적인 미래를 함께 만들고 싶다면 CFS 와 함께하세요.

직무 소개

Automation Maintenance 팀은 물류센터 내에 구축된 다양한 자동화 설비를 직접 운영·관리하며 안정적인 센터 운영을 지원하는 조직입니다. 상품 분류 설비인 소터(Sorter), 무인 이동 로봇인 자동 유도 차량(Automated Guided Vehicle)과 자율 이동 로봇(Autonomous Mobile Robot), 자동 라벨링 및 패키징 설비, 로봇 암, 컨베이어 등 핵심 자동화 장비의 유지보수와 성능 관리를 담당합니다. 또한 신규 자동화 설비 도입과 지속적인 개선 활동을 통해 현장 근로자의 작업 효율을 높이고 생산성을 극대화합니다. 이를 통해 물류 운영의 안정성과 품질을 강화하며, 쿠팡의 핵심 가치인 고객 만족 실현에 기여합니다.

업무 내용

• 물류센터 내 자동화 설비의 유지보수 및 예방보전 활동 수행

• - 설비 예시: 컨베이어, 자동 분류기(오토소터), 자동 저장 시스템(OSR) 등

• 주요 설비 운영 지표 분석 및 관리

• - 예시: MTBF(고장 간 평균 시간), MTTR(평균 수리 시간) 등

• 교대조 관리 및 조원 교육 진행
• 스페어 파츠 등 부품의 적정 재고 수준 관리

자격 요건

• 4년 이상의 기계/전기/제어 분야 경력 및 5인 이상 팀의 목표 관리 경험 보유자
• 설비 보전 경험 보유자
• 주·야간 교대근무 가능자 (교대근무 형태는 센터별 상이함)

우대 사항

• 자동화 설비 개선 경험을 보유하신 분
• 기계/전기 관련 기능사 이상의 자격증을 보유하신 분
• PLC 로직/Inverter Parameter 수정 또는 HMI 작화 및 수정이 가능하신 분

근무 위치

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

• 전형 절차

• 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격

• 참고 사항

• 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
• 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
• 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.

• 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
• 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12 주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

• 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy

서류 반환 정책

• 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.

ROLE: SENIOR MEDIA DIRECTOR
TEAM: MEDIA
LOCATION: TORONTO (HYBRID 2X/WEEK)

COMPANY OVERVIEW

At Salt Media, we're on a mission to earn the world's attention. As the media division of Salt XC, we're building a different kind of agency where media, commerce, creative, data and technology work as a single connected team. Our people combine strategic thinking with AI-powered tools, automation and advanced analytics to help some of North America's most recognized brands solve complex business challenges and drive measurable growth. We move quickly, challenge convention, and believe the best ideas come from curious people who are empowered to experiment. If you're looking to do career-defining work alongside smart, ambitious teammates in an environment that's shaping the future of media, we'd love to meet you.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Senior Media Director, you’ll set the strategic direction for how media investment is planned, bought, and optimized across CPG clients in North America. Operating at the intersection of media strategy and team leadership, you’ll ensure every plan is grounded in strong channel logic, sound investment principles, and a clear line to business outcomes.

You’ll own cross-channel strategy and plan alignment across your portfolio, setting the optimization roadmap and reporting rhythm that keeps campaigns performing against KPIs. You’ll lead a team of media managers and directors — training them on tools and platforms, mentoring their growth, and ensuring the team’s segmentation and audience strategies stay sharp as channels evolve.

You bring a senior media point of view that Account leads and clients rely on, and a team looks up to. You move fluidly between investment strategy and hands-on problem-solving, and you know how to translate performance data into a clear learning agenda for the whole team.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Media Planning & Buying

• Lead plan development and investment approach across your portfolio, ensuring every plan is grounded in strong strategic rationale.
• Set standards for I/O accuracy, spec compliance, and buy execution across the team.
• Own the relationship and day-to-day investment approach with key media platforms and partners, escalating and resolving issues as they arise.
• Partner with Account leadership to align media investment with broader account strategy and business objectives.

Integrated Media Strategy

• Own cross-channel strategy and plan alignment for your portfolio, ensuring full-funnel thinking connects to brand and business objectives.
• Translate client briefs into integrated, cross-channel investment approaches that scale across accounts.
• Guide Account and Creative partners on how channel strategy supports the broader campaign narrative.

Measurement, Analytics & Reporting

• Lead post-campaign reporting and the learning agenda across your portfolio, ensuring insights translate into sharper future plans.
• Build stakeholder trust in the measurement approach, aligning on what success looks like (e.g., brand-building vs. performance KPIs) before campaigns launch.
• Guide the team on complex channel plans and measurement matrices, including test-and-learn frameworks.

Media Tools & Platform Fluency

• Train and support the team on platform and tool use, ensuring consistent, fluent execution across the portfolio.
• Maintain platform reliability and troubleshoot tool-related issues that affect delivery.
• Stay current on new platform capabilities and flag opportunities to apply them across accounts.

Performance Optimization & Testing

• Set the optimization roadmap for your portfolio and drive its implementation across the team.
• Ensure consistent delivery against KPIs, stepping in to course-correct underperforming campaigns.
• Champion a test-and-learn mindset, ensuring findings are documented and applied across future plans.

Channel & Audience Expertise

• Build segmentation strategies and platform-specific audience logic that sharpen targeting across your portfolio.
• Guide the team on applying audience insights and platform data to refine channel-specific approaches.
• Stay ahead of shifts in channel and audience behavior, bringing new thinking to the team and to clients.

Leadership, Management & Administration

• Manage and develop direct reports across the media team; own performance conversations, goal-setting, and career development planning.
• Build team capability and bench strength through deliberate coaching, structured feedback, and stretch assignments.
• Model the leadership behaviors and professional standards that define Salt Media’s team culture.
• Contribute to team-wide planning processes, hiring decisions, and operational improvements in partnership with departmental leadership.
• Champion a culture of accountability, clarity, and continuous improvement within your media team.

EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

• 8–12 years of experience in media planning, buying, or investment strategy, including 5+ years in a senior media leadership role within a media or integrated agency.
• Proven track record leading cross-channel media strategy and investment across a portfolio of clients or campaigns.
• Demonstrated people management experience, including direct report oversight, performance management, and career development.
• Deep fluency across media platforms, tools, and measurement systems, with the ability to train and elevate a team’s capability.
• Strong analytical acumen, with experience translating performance data into a clear learning agenda and optimization roadmap.
• Excellent communicator and confident senior presenter; able to align Account, Creative, and client stakeholders around a media point of view.
• Strategically minded, with the ability to connect media investment to measurable business outcomes.
• Highly organized, decisive, and calm under pressure; able to lead a team through ambiguity while maintaining clarity of direction.

PERKS & BENEFITS THAT SET US APART

We don’t just talk about balance, growth, and culture, we build for it:

• Work-Life Flexibility: Hybrid setup, up to 28 paid days off and winter holiday shutdowns.
• Comprehensive Coverage: Health, dental, and vision plans, plus Salt Bucks to spend on what matters to you - wellness, RRSPs, or extra time off.
• Growth-Driven Culture: Dedicated Salt Days, learning access, and formal leadership development.
• Celebration-First Mentality: Legendary team trips, seasonal socials, and Salt Swag that reps your squad.
• Real Rewards: Referral and new business bonuses, phone reimbursement to support your everyday work, exclusive lifestyle perks, and personalized wellness options.
• Culture of Belonging: DEI programs, active ERGs, and a workplace where every voice counts.

WHAT WE STAND FOR

• Salt of the Earth: We lead with humility, honesty, and heart — always.
• Do What’s Right: No shortcuts. We choose integrity over ease, every time.
• Earn Your Salt: We roll up our sleeves, chase results, and celebrate the journey.
• Make Things Better: We’re solution-seekers, always pushing for smarter ways forward.
• Seek Different Perspectives: Diversity fuels our thinking. Inclusion drives our impact.

The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is $140,000–$150,000. Individual compensation within this range is determined based on job-related factors such as experience, skills, level of responsibility, internal equity, and business needs. This range represents the expected base salary for this role and does not include other elements of SALT’s total rewards program.

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

쿠팡 Rocket Growth는 고객이 신뢰할 수 있는 상품 정보를 제공하고 최고의 쇼핑 경험을 제공하기 위해 Listing Quality와 Catalog Quality를 지속적으로 개선하고 있습니다. 본 포지션은 Listing 및 Catalog 관련 품질 이슈를 발견하고, 문제를 정의하며, 데이터 기반으로 해결책을 수립하고 실행하는 동시에 오퍼레이션 조직을 리드하는 역할입니다. 단순한 운영 관리자가 아닌, 고객 경험(CX), 셀러 경험(SX), 비즈니스 임팩트를 종합적으로 고려하여 문제를 해결하는 Program Manager 역할을 수행하게 됩니다. 운영 조직을 통해 품질을 안정적으로 관리하는 동시에, 정책·프로세스·시스템 개선을 통해 운영 의존도를 줄이고 자동화를 확대하는 것이 핵심 미션입니다.

업무 내용

• 상품명, 이미지, 속성, 카탈로그 그룹핑 및 번들 등 상품 정보 품질 이슈 발굴 및 개선 과제 관리
• 고객 경험과 셀러 경험 향상을 위한 데이터 기반 품질 이슈 분석 및 우선순위 수립
• Listing Quality 오퍼레이션 조직 리딩 및 약 6~10명 규모의 운영 인력 성과 관리
• 운영 프로세스 및 표준 운영 절차(SOP) 구축을 통한 품질 관리 체계 강화
• 생산성, 정확도, 서비스 수준 협약(SLA), 결함률(Defect Rate) 등 주요 운영 지표 관리 및 개선 활동 수행
• 품질 이슈에 대한 근본 원인 분석과 운영 데이터 기반 인사이트 도출
• 신규 운영 프로그램 설계 및 확장을 통한 품질 개선과 운영 효율화 추진

자격 요건

• Program Management, Operations Management 또는 관련 분야에서 2년 이상의 경력이 있으신 분
• 최소 5명 이상의 운영 조직 또는 프로젝트 팀을 리딩한 경험이 있으신 분
• 데이터 기반으로 문제를 분석하고 개선 과제를 도출한 경험이 있으신 분
• Excel, SQL, Tableau 등 데이터 분석 도구 활용 경험이 있으신 분
• 다양한 이해관계자와 협업하며 프로젝트 또는 운영 개선 과제를 주도한 경험이 있으신 분

우대 사항

• 이커머스, 오픈마켓, 마켓플레이스, 카탈로그 또는 콘텐츠 품질 관리 경험이 있으신 분
• 상품 정보 품질 개선을 위한 정책, 프로세스 또는 시스템 고도화 경험이 있으신 분
• Product, Engineering, Data Science, Catalog Policy 등 유관 조직과 협업하여 문제를 해결한 경험이 있으신 분
• 대규모 Quality Management 또는 Audit 프로그램 운영 경험이 있으신 분
• 이커머스 플랫폼 환경에서의 근무 경험이 있으신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

• 전형절차

• 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격
• 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
• 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

• 참고사항

• 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
• 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
• 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
• 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
• 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
• 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

• 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/

서류 반환 정책

• 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
• 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
• 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
• 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.

Headquartered in the US and listed in NYSE, the Company operates in countries across the Americas, Europe, Africa, and Asia Pacific. Product types include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, AD&D, Disability, Travel, etc. are sold to groups. For our Business Excellence team we are looking for a Planning Senior analyst Your job As a Senior Analyst you will be responsible for developing and managing short, medium, and long-term forecast volumes for all functions based on historical data and financial projections on membership. This role translates operational strategy into capacity plans for both inshore and offshore operations, manages headcount and productivity, and coordinates capacity planning to meet service level agreements. Main Responsibilities 1. Forecasting and Planning: - Create long, medium, and short-term forecast volumes for all functions based on historical data and financial projections on membership. - Translate operational strategy into capacity plans for inshore and offshore teams. - Measure and plan for attrition rates, leaves of absence, and headcount control within each capacity plan. - Update work ratios and plan holiday/sickness quotas for each site and function. 2. Productivity Management: - Control and set productivity targets in collaboration with Operations Managers for each function. - Monitor and ensure targets are met, adjusting plans as necessary to maintain efficiency. 3. Service Level Projections: - Develop projections for claims, COM inventory, and telephony service levels. - Utilize call volume reports to coordinate and complete capacity planning within the call center. - Conduct call pattern forecasting and planning to help meet service level agreements. 4. Communication and Collaboration: - Communicate effectively with multiple levels of management to agree on each capacity plan and ensure assumptions are being met. - Clearly communicate recommendations and guidance to senior operational leaders. - Act as the single point of contact for the entire team and senior leaders. 5. Cost Management: - Translate changes in capacity plans into costs and drivers. - Communicate with Finance, HR, Training, and other relevant departments regarding Full-Time Equivalents (FTEs) per site and function. Your profile - Proven experience in capacity planning, workforce management, or a related area. - Min. 3+ years operational planning experience - Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret historical data and financial projections. Proven data analytics skills (advanced Excel, QlikView, Qilksense) preferred - Excellent communication skills, capable of conveying complex information to senior leaders. - Experience in workforce management software and tools. - Experience with understanding of IVR, ACD & other call delivery technology platforms - Ability to work collaboratively across various departments and levels of management. - Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Skills Strategically orientated with a focus on execution and delivery. Results driven and able to work under pressure. Excellent inter-personal skills. Creativity/Innovation Action-orientated problem-solving skills / process improvement. Excellent organization, planning and prioritization skills. Strong communication skills: demonstrating drive and enthusiasm. Adaptability and Cooperation Advanced level of English (additional languages are a plus). Position Purpose: The Sr. Data Scientist is responsible for leading data science initiatives that drive business profitability, increased efficiencies and improved customer experience. This role assists in the development of the Home Depot advanced analytics infrastructure that informs decision making. Sr. Data Scientists are expected to seek out business opportunities to leverage data science as a competitive advantage. Based on the specific data science team, this role would need to be Proficient in one or more data science specializations, such as optimization, computer vision, recommendation, search or NLP. As a Sr. Data Scientist, you will serve as a lead on data science projects, collaborating with project/product managers, providing prioritization of tasks, balancing workload and mentoring data scientists on the project team. This role is expected to present insights and recommendations to leaders and business partners and explain the benefits and impacts of the recommended solutions. This role supports the building of skilled and talented data science teams by providing input to staffing needs and participating in the recruiting and hiring process. In addition, Data Scientists collaborate with business partners and cross-functional teams, requiring effective communication skills, building relationships and partnerships, and leveraging business proficiency to solutions and recommendations. Key Responsibilities: 35% Solution Development - Proficiently design and develop algorithms and models to use against large datasets to create business insights; Execute tasks with high levels of efficiency and quality; Make appropriate selection, utilization and interpretation of advanced analytical methodologies; Effectively communicate insights and recommendations to both technical and non-technical leaders and business customers/partners; Prepare reports, updates and/or presentations related to progress made on a project or solution; Clearly communicate impacts of recommendations to drive alignment and appropriate implementation 30% Project Management & Team Support - Work with project teams and business partners to determine project goals; Provide direction on prioritization of work and ensure quality of work; Provide mentoring and coaching to more junior roles to support their technical competencies; Collaborate with managers and team in the distribution of workload and resources; Support recruiting and hiring efforts for the team 20% Business Collaboration - Leverage extensive business knowledge into solution approach; Effectively develop trust and collaboration with internal customers and cross-functional teams; Participate in the continuous improvement of data science and analytics by developing replicable solutions (for example, codified data products, project documentation, process flowcharts) to ensure solutions are leveraged for future projects; Define best practices and develop clear vision for data analysis and model productionalization; Contribute to library of reusable algorithms for future use, ensuring developed codes are documented Direct Manager/Direct Reports: This position reports to manager or above This position has 0 Direct Reports Travel Requirements: Typically requires overnight travel less than 10% of the time. Minimum Qualifications: Must be eighteen years of age or older. Must be legally permitted to work in the United States. Preferred Qualifications: PhD in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Math, Statistics, etc.) 6+ years of experience in business intelligence and analytics Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Power Point Proficient in a modern scripting language (preferably Python) Proficient running queries against data (preferably with Google BigQuery or SQL) Proficient with data visualization software (preferably Tableau) Mastery utilizing statistical techniques to identify key insights that help solve business problems Proficient in Prescriptive Modeling like optimization, computer vision, recommendation, search or NLP Demonstrated proficiency in predictive modeling, data mining and data analysis Minimum Education: The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a bachelor's degree program or equivalent degree in a field of study related to the job.
